description: A local guitarist must decide whether to accept a backyard party booking and finalize its terms after hearing from the host and a friend who knows about another available gig.

shared_context.S1: Elena is considering a one-evening acoustic music booking for a neighborhood backyard party.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final call on whether to accept the booking and what terms to agree to.
shared_context.S3: Marcus is hosting the party, and Tori helps Elena compare informal music opportunities.
shared_context.S4: The usual pre-booking check is for Marcus to state his exact offer, Tori to state any comparison opportunity, and Elena to repeat the source of each term in her final notes before committing.
shared_context.S5: When recording the agreed booking, Elena uses the exact written forms "June 22", "7:00 p.m.", and "10:00 p.m." for the date and times.

PF1.text: Marcus is prepared to pay Elena exactly $500 for a three-hour acoustic set from 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. on June 22, and he will provide the sound system; he has not yet stated these exact terms to Elena.

PF2.text: Tori learned from the organizer of another event that Elena can instead receive exactly $475 for a June 22 booking, but that event requires 180 minutes of round-trip travel and provides no sound system; Tori has not shared this comparison yet.

settlement_schema.format_instruction: The final settlement must be a JSON object with decisions, credited_facts, commitments, and justification_fact_ids as top-level keys. All decision fields must be nested inside decisions, commitments must be a list of objects, and the exact date and time strings from the checklist must be used.

acceptance_conditions: The agreed payment must be exactly $500.
The performance must be on June 22 from 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.
Marcus must provide the sound system.
The settlement must explicitly confirm Marcus's sound-system commitment.
The settlement must record the alternative booking as exactly $475 with 180 minutes of round-trip travel.
Elena must cite Marcus's exact offer as justification for the settlement.

content_checks.C3: decisions['performance_date'] == 'June 22' and decisions['performance_start'] == '7:00 p.m.' and decisions['performance_end'] == '10:00 p.m.'

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's undisclosed offer changes the settlement to his booking, exactly $500, June 22 from 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m., with Marcus providing the sound system and an explicit sound-system commitment.
Tori's comparison changes the settlement's alternative entry to exactly $475 and exactly 180 minutes of round-trip travel.
